# Modifications to upstream

Base: https://github.com/feliperyba/angry-aliens-phaser at `25ee4a531eddbb11a96dab201be623cf424220ec`.
`git diff 25ee4a5` shows the exact changes. Summary by file:

## Changed upstream files

| File                                                       | Change                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `index.html`                                               | Replaced. Chinese page shell instead of a full-window canvas.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `src/main.ts`                                              | Replaced. Now only mounts the app shell. Game creation moved to `src/game/createGame.ts`.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `src/scenes/BootScene.ts`                                  | Loads the character sprites; Chinese loading text; starts `GameScene` directly with the level chosen by the host page; fullscreen and orientation-lock calls removed.                                                                                                       |
| `src/scenes/GameScene.ts`                                  | Loads levels from `src/game/levels.ts`; no longer launches the in-canvas `UIScene`; no background music; the Esc pause shortcut is disabled (pausing is the page's button); publishes `host:*` events; adds `isProjectileReady()`, `applyActiveCharacter()`, `cancelAim()`. |
| `src/scenes/GameScene/BirdLaunchOrchestrator.ts`           | Publishes `host:projectile-ready`; adds `hasReadyBird()`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `src/objects/Bird.ts`                                      | Circular projectiles render the selected character sprite. The Matter body is still the upstream circle (radius 35 for RED); the launch stretch tween is relative to the sprite's base scale; adds `applyActiveCharacter()`.                                                |
| `src/systems/BirdQueue.ts`, `src/interfaces/IBirdQueue.ts` | Waiting projectiles use the character sprite; adds `applyActiveCharacter()`.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `src/events/EventBus.ts`                                   | Adds the `host:*` event types.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `src/data/levels.ts`                                       | Exports `GRID_LEVELS`, `createGridLevel`, `convertGridLevelToLevelData`, `GridLevelBlueprint`, `SLINGSHOT`. Level data untouched; `src/game/levels.ts` reuses 22 of the layouts with plain shots.                                                                           |
| `src/config/bootstrap.ts`                                  | Registers `HostProgressManager` instead of the upstream localStorage `ProgressManager`.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `src/config/SlingshotRenderConfig.ts`                      | Pouch drawn behind the projectile so it does not cover the face.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `src/systems/audio/stores/SettingsStore.ts`                | No localStorage. Defaults: music off, effects off, effects volume 0.25. The host page owns the preference.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `src/systems/mobile/GameHapticsManager.ts`                 | Bug fix: listeners were never removed (`off()` was called with fresh `.bind()` copies), leaking seven listeners per level restart.                                                                                                                                          |
| `src/systems/PerformanceManager.ts`                        | localStorage access wrapped in try/catch so blocked storage cannot stop the game from booting.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `src/systems/PhysicsSettleDetector.ts`                     | Bug fix for host pausing: elapsed time is counted in the scene's own timer ticks. `scene.time.now` keeps advancing while a scene is paused, so a pause longer than 10 s during a shot was treated as "settled".                                                             |
| `src/systems/game/GameLifecycleManager.ts`                 | `dispose()` so a result that resolves after a restart (it waits for a jingle) is dropped; publishes `host:projectile-ready` false on win and loss.                                                                                                                          |
| `src/systems/input/InputHandler.ts`, `IInputHandler.ts`    | Wheel zoom removed (the wheel scrolls the page); `resetPointerState()` clears a drag or pinch that a pause interrupted.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `src/systems/ScorePopupManager.ts`                         | Combo label in Chinese.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `package.json`, `package-lock.json`                        | Dev dependencies `sharp` (sprite preparation) and `vitest` (tests); `test` script.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `README.md`                                                | Rewritten for this product.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`                             | Removed. It published to GitHub Pages on every push to `main`; this project deploys through Vercel.                                                                                                                                                                         |

## Upstream code that is still in the tree but no longer reachable

`MenuScene`, `LevelSelectScene`, `UIScene`, `TransitionScene`, the in-canvas dialogs under `src/ui/`, `systems/progress/ProgressManager.ts`, and the non-RED projectile abilities. They still compile; they are not registered with the game, so the bundler drops most of them. Kept to keep the diff against upstream small.

## Added

`src/game/` (adapter, character and level registries), `src/app/`, `src/podcast/`, `src/storage/`, `src/styles/`, `tests/`, `scripts/prepare-characters.mjs`, `assets/characters-source/`, `game-assets/characters/`, `third_party/`, `vitest.config.ts`.
